timelineEvents.title: Earliest published cabaret songs
timelineEvents.label: 1926 · Earliest published cabaret songs
timelineEvents.shortDescription: Kaper’s Warsaw cabaret songs appeared in print under the pseudonym Bruno Asper, which he had already used in 1923.
timelineEvents.longDescription: Songs for Warsaw cabarets appeared under the pseudonym Bruno Asper, to words by Andrzej Włast. The printed editions of 1926 are the earliest published songs documented here; the signature itself is older, appearing on the 1923 manuscript of Koszutski Girls.
